mage.name: Mage
passives: **Start of turn** Gain 3 mana. You can't have more than 4 mana at once. **End of turn** Lose 3 mana.
Your spells gain +1 to their invoke values.
Once per turn, when you play a card, you may treat its printed element as any single other element of your choice.
mage.prepare: Refresh 1 spent mana, up to your mana limit.
mage.invoke: Spend any amount of mana. The invoke value equals the mana spent.

monarch.name: Monarch
passives: **End of turn** Tax: pay 1 gold for every 4 gold you have. Keep the rest for your next turn.
Your units enter play with +1 HP.
Once per turn, one of your units can attack another unit without tier restrictions.
monarch.invoke: Spend up to 10 gold at once. The invoke value equals the gold spent.
